stages.prompt: Our product matching prototype already produces three-number vectors; don't generate embeddings. Create CatalogItem with sku and label as text, and coordinates as a list of Float32 values. Add an exact FLAT vector index with three dimensions and Euclidean distance. The catalog is small, so exact answers matter more than scaling right now.

params.name: schema
params.sdl: type CatalogItem { sku: String label: String coordinates: [Float32!] @index(vector:{dimensions:3,flat:{metric:EUCLIDEAN}}) }
